title: Sandbox dry-run code sanity check
caveat: This is a mocked structural executability check with fake SDK, import, subprocess, file, and network stubs. It is not a live cloud-service execution benchmark.

metrics.sandbox_success: Percentage of extracted Python scripts that complete under the dry-run harness before timeout.
metrics.runtime_pa: Main-scene preference adherence over runtime call events only; higher is better.
metrics.runtime_ia: Mean instruction adherence over runtime call events only; higher is better.
metrics.runtime_dr: Distractor-provider activation over runtime call events only; lower is better.

takeaway: Prompt-only baselines can achieve high sandbox success while still activating many distractor providers at runtime.
COPILOT-DLM is not the highest method on sandbox success alone, but it gives much stronger runtime provider control than prompt-only baselines.
The Plan+Template Anchor variant narrows the gap to COPILOT-DLM, which suggests that provider-bearing structure is important, while the DLM draft still provides a complete method instance.
